_comment: Review status of each locale's draft translations. English (en) is the source of truth. Any key missing from a locale falls back to English automatically (see src/i18n/request.ts). Update `reviewed` to true once a fluent speaker has checked a namespace.

locales._note: The app-side namespaces (`tasks`, `focus`) exist in English only and fall back to English everywhere else. They are translated once the product surfaces they describe stop changing shape — translating a screen that is still being built means retranslating it.

marketing.note: Chrome + headings + feature titles translated; long-form prose (benefit paragraphs, feature descriptions, FAQ answers, whoItsFor bullets, testimonial quotes) falls back to English pending fluent review.
